Alex: FYI we're scheduling a rolling kernel CVE patch across gpu-fleet-eu1 and gpu-fleet-us1. Window: Tue 2026-06-10 22:00-02:00 UTC. Reboot plan = stagger by rack, target ~12 racks/day, ~12% of capacity in-flight, estimated peak capacity dip ~10%. Pause 10m between racks with health checks.

Maria: Important: what are the Dedicated / Reserved capacity guarantees during this? Any automatic failover configured?

Alex: Dedicated routes remain preferred. We've reserved a small emergency buffer for enterprise pods; if burst limits hit, requests fall back to cpu-burst nodes with degraded perf. No SLA modification expected. Ops will monitor queue length and p95 latency.

Jin: Eviction strategy? We need to avoid cache thrash for long-lived model containers.

Alex: We'll cordon then drain with graceful timeout 600s. For cache-heavy workloads we'll attempt live migrate using pod-affinity hints to siblings prior to cordon. If migration fails, mark node for manual intervention and skip reboot.

ops-bot: [sched] maintenance created: id=mtn-20260610-22, owners=infra-oncall, notify=#eng-infra,#support at 2026-06-08T09:00Z

Sam: Add a pre-flight check to runbook and upload snapshots of capacity and pod-distribution. Quick example:
```
# preflight
./scripts/pool-snapshot --pools gpu-fleet-eu1,gpu-fleet-us1 --out /tmp/mtn-preflight.json
kubectl get pods -n inference -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.status.phase=="Running") | {name: .metadata.name, node: .spec.nodeName, containerStatuses: .status.containerStatuses}' > /tmp/pods-running.json
```

Tilly: Cross-region consideration: batching flows sometimes split across eu->us. If eu dips we risk egress cost spikes. Can we cap cross-region spill to 6%?

Alex: Yes. We'll set cross-region spill cap to 6% and enable a temporary per-route cost limiter. Posting the config change to runbook after tests.

Maria: Please also block non-essential merges and infra deploys touching inference between 21:30-03:00 UTC. We should avoid noisy deploys during the window.

Alex: Agreed. I'll register a deploy-freeze with deploy-bot.

Jin: Suggest reducing live batch limits to prevent OOM during the window. Proposed env override: BATCH_TOKEN_LIMIT=800.

Alex: We'll push a feature flag and runtime override:
```
routes:
  default-inference:
    max_batch_tokens: 800
    cross_region_spill_pct: 6
```

Sam: Include a rollback step if latency p95 > 250ms for > 10m. Rollback should uncordon nodes in reverse order and revert batch override. Also include signal checklist: KV hit rate, model load time, queue depth.

Alex: Added rollback: cancel reboots, uncordon nodes (if health >= 85%), revert runtime flags. Ops checklist copied to runbook.
